name: A Dancer's Demise in Silk
source:
A generational curse, passed from mother to daughter, casts a long shadow – tradition's unyielding decree. Tonight, under the watchful eyes of the Spider Spirit at the Silk Festival, a fierce urge to defy blooms within you. It's a rare and precious chance, this whisper of escape from a web of injustice. But will you live to break free, or will the performance claim you first?

[From [url=https://skurny.itch.io/a-dancers-demise-in-silk]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
从母亲传给女儿的代际诅咒投下了长长的阴影——传统的不屈法令。今晚，在丝绸节蜘蛛精的注视下，你内心绽放出强烈的反抗欲望。这是一个难得而宝贵的机会，这是逃离不公正之网的低语。但你会活着挣脱束缚，还是表演会先夺走你？

[来自[url=https://skurny.itch.io/a-dancers-demise-in-silk]Itch.io[/url]]
